registration_1mm_frame.decision: NOT applied. Photograph vs atlas meshes in this frame: right (-1, 0) px, left (-1, -3) px = photographed anatomy ~1 mm anterior of the atlas (both sides; same direction as Q173's 2.35 mm on the 0.33 mm crops but under half of it and within one voxel) and left-side ~3 mm medial (Q173: 2.4-2.5 mm, same direction). The only above-voxel component is left-only and cannot be applied as one affine to a volume with midline structures (EAS, levator sheets meeting at the midline) without tearing them; the builder stays label-consistent (0 voxels in his bone/organ labels). Also found: legs_total's labels vs the photographs after the flip are off by right (-3,-5) / left (0,-1) px (a ~1.7 % scale + ~0.8 deg misfit of the frame calibration), so exclusions carry a few-mm misfit on his right side -- not corrected here (open).
